svg.title: A product can pass through several exchanges
svg.desc: Fictional network model: a product made in China passes through an unnamed possible exchange stop before use or deposition at a Philippine site. The unnamed stop and links are invented to explain indirect exchange.

g.text: A product can pass through several exchanges
The middle stop is fictional. Connections illustrate a possibility.
Knowing origin and destination does not prove every stop or trader.
Teaching model or source summary; not a map of a documented voyage.
